children: Sui has scheduled the launch of Agent Pass, Warrant and Rooms for Q4 2026. Agent Pass covers personal agent delegation, Warrant covers business agent permissions, and Rooms supports interactions with customer agents.

Rooms records activity on Walrus, with those records anchored on Sui. This connects customer-agent interactions to Sui through their recorded activity. The launch adds agent products without a stated change to the token's economics.

title: Sui: Agent Pass, Warrant and Rooms launch for agent delegation and permissions - Q4 2026
